# Lab 16.18: Enable OS Login & Block Project-wide SSH Keys

## What We Are Going to Do
Replace SSH keys in metadata with OS Login, so VM access is controlled by IAM and every login is tied to a real identity.

## Steps

1. **See the old way.** Go to **Compute Engine → Metadata → SSH keys**. Keys here work on every VM in the project, and nobody tracks who owns them.

2. **Enable OS Login for the project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute project-info add-metadata --metadata=enable-oslogin=TRUE</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create a VM** and block project-wide keys on it.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create oslogin-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --metadata=block-project-ssh-keys=TRUE</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Grant login rights with IAM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances add-iam-policy-binding oslogin-vm --zone=us-central1-a \
  --member=user:alice@YOUR_DOMAIN --role=roles/compute.osLogin
gcloud compute instances add-iam-policy-binding oslogin-vm --zone=us-central1-a \
  --member=user:sam@YOUR_DOMAIN --role=roles/compute.osAdminLogin</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test.** Alice can SSH but `sudo` fails. Sam can SSH and use `sudo`. Removing the role removes access at once.

6. **Add 2-step verification for SSH** (optional).


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances add-metadata oslogin-vm --zone=us-central1-a \
  --metadata=enable-oslogin-2fa=TRUE</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **Enforce it everywhere.** In **Organization policies**, enforce **Require OS login** (`compute.requireOsLogin`).

8. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete oslogin-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute project-info remove-metadata --keys=enable-oslogin</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| SSH access | Granted and removed with IAM |
| `compute.osLogin` | Login without sudo |
| `compute.osAdminLogin` | Login with sudo |
| Project-wide keys | Ignored on this VM |
